digest.component_or_area: rebar-usage template and portable claim guidance
propositions: rebar claim command documentation should omit --assignee flag and rely on ticket.default_assignee configuration when available
assignee specification must support three states: configured default, empty configuration with no assignee, and explicit override with email/accountId for Jira-reconciled stores
link inventory must include caused_by relation alongside existing six relations
plan review guidance must order prerequisite ticket review before dependent ticket review
generated region in templates/AGENTS.md must synchronize byte-for-byte with canonical templates/rebar-usage.md
portable template must contain no repository-specific Gerrit workflow guidance
